game.name: nmmo
game.description: PufferLib's Ocean NMMO3 (Neural MMO 3) as a Coworld: a persistent 512x512 survival world, bit-exact with the upstream training environment (same C sim compiled to wasm, same 1707-byte observations and 26-way discrete actions). Eight free-for-all agents harvest resources, fight enemies, level combat and profession skills, and equip gear; death or 500-tick stagnation respawns an agent in place. Episodes end at the tick cap; seats are ranked by score: mean min(combat, profession) level per life, summed over the seat's agents — normalizing by lives makes every death hurt, so suicide-respawn farming never pays. Replays re-simulate deterministically in a static wasm viewer from the recorded seed and per-tick action log.

seed.description: Deterministic sim seed. Omitted: the server derives a fresh random seed and records it in results and the replay header.

tokens.description: One connection token per player seat, indexed by seat slot. Injected by the runner; never authored.

players.description: One player display-name object per seat, indexed by seat slot. Total sim agents = players x heroes_per_seat (num_agents is elastic upstream; the default variant is 8 seats x 1 agent, free-for-all).

max_ticks.description: Tick cap; reaching it ends the episode (NMMO3 has no in-env termination) with seats ranked by score.

num_agents.description: Number of agent seats; must equal the player slot count. Used by the platform ladder service for block seating; ignored by the game server.

heroes_per_seat.description: Sim agents each seat controls (default 1: one agent per policy, free-for-all). Capped at 4 so total sim agents (players x heroes_per_seat, players capped at 16) never exceed 64 - comfortably under the replay viewer's 1024-agent bound (sim/viewer_main.c VIEWER_MAX_AGENTS) and the tested world-population range.

tick_deadline_ms.description: Per-tick action deadline in milliseconds; a late/missing/malformed reply plays the no-op action for that seat's agents.

wall_clock_budget_seconds.description: Engine wall-clock hard stop: a slow episode ends itself with end_reason wall_clock (scores read as they stand, artifacts written) once this much real time has elapsed. Default: min(0.9 x episode_timeout_minutes x 60, max_ticks x tick_deadline_ms / 1000) - always under the platform's episode_timeout_minutes container kill, which would lose results and replay.

player_connect_timeout_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for all seats to connect before starting; seats that never connect play no-op and are reported to COGAME_PLAYER_FAILURE_URI.

seed.description: The deterministic sim seed the episode ran with.

names.description: One player name per seat, in seat-slot order.

scores.description: One scalar score per seat (higher = better): per agent, the mean min(combat, profession) level per life — cumulative min over ended lives plus the final life's min, divided by lives (deaths + 1) — summed over the seat's agents. Normalizing by lives kills the suicide-farming exploit (raw cumulative score would reward dying to bank min >= 1 and respawn). Episodes have no winner; ranking consumers order by this value. sim_fault episodes score all seats 0.0 (equal = drawn).

dead_seats.description: Per-seat strike-rule dead flag at episode end (10 consecutive missed ticks marks a seat dead; a valid reply revives it).

end_reason.description: Why the episode ended: the tick cap was reached, the engine's wall-clock budget expired, or the sim reported an internal fault (sim_fault: all scores 0.0, partial replay). NMMO3 has no in-env termination.

noop_ticks.description: Per-seat count of ticks played as the no-op fallback (late, missing, malformed, or dead seat).

deaths.description: Ended lives: attack deaths plus 500-tick stagnation resets.

time_alive.description: Ticks since the final life spawned.

cum_min_comb_prof.description: Sum of min(comb_lvl, prof_lvl) over the agent's ended lives.

agent_stats.description: Per-agent end-of-episode score breakdown, indexed by agent pid; seat i owns pids [i*heroes_per_seat, (i+1)*heroes_per_seat) — with the default heroes_per_seat=1 this is the per-seat breakdown.

noop_causes.description: Per-seat NOOP-fallback cause counters. timeout/malformed/disconnected/host_error partition noop_ticks; wrong_tick counts mis-addressed reply messages at the transport (such a tick also counts as timeout).

reward_sums.description: Per-seat sum of the sim's per-agent training rewards over the episode.

state_digest.description: u32 sim state digest at episode end; a re-simulation of the replay (seed + recorded actions) must reproduce it. 0 for sim_fault episodes whose state was unreadable.

player.name: baseline
player.description: Upstream PufferLib pretrained MMONet policy (nmmo3_weights.bin) run through the demo network forward pass compiled to wasm - the exact network the sim was trained with. Image placeholder is replaced at deploy time.

variants.name: Default (8 seats FFA)
variants.description: Eight seats, one agent each: free-for-all survival, seats ranked by score: mean min(combat, profession) level per life.
